steps.title: Initialize Project Structure
steps.description: Create the basic HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript files for the new web application.

steps.title: Configure Tailwind CSS
steps.description: Add the Tailwind CSS CDN to index.html for utility-first styling.

steps.title: Design Core Layout
steps.description: Create a central container for the counter application using Flexbox to center content.

steps.title: Implement Counter Display
steps.description: Add an HTML element to display the current counter value.

steps.title: Create Increment Button
steps.description: Add a button to increase the counter value, styled with Tailwind CSS.

steps.title: Create Decrement Button
steps.description: Add a button to decrease the counter value, styled with Tailwind CSS.

steps.title: Create Reset Button
steps.description: Add a button to reset the counter value to zero, styled with Tailwind CSS.

steps.title: Initialize JavaScript Counter State
steps.description: Define the initial counter value in script.js and get references to UI elements.

steps.title: Implement Increment Logic
steps.description: Write the JavaScript function to increment the counter value.

steps.title: Implement Decrement Logic
steps.description: Write the JavaScript function to decrement the counter value.

steps.title: Implement Reset Logic
steps.description: Write the JavaScript function to reset the counter value to zero.

steps.title: Create Update Display Function
steps.description: Develop a function to refresh the counter display in the UI with the current value.

steps.title: Attach Event Listeners
steps.description: Bind the increment, decrement, and reset functions to their respective buttons.

steps.title: Add Basic Responsiveness
steps.description: Ensure the counter layout adapts gracefully to different screen sizes using Tailwind's responsive utilities.

steps.title: Enhance UI with Tailwind Styles
steps.description: Apply additional Tailwind CSS classes to improve the visual appeal of the counter and buttons.

steps.title: Building simplecounter
steps.description: The Simple Counter web application is now complete and ready for use.
